verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a training opt-out, a data-controls toggle, or a statement that user data is excluded from model training. The closest items are vague business-workspace claims of 'enterprise-grade privacy protections' and conversations 'protected under business plan terms'. These are adjacent privacy statements that never mention training use, so they earn no credit; the API docs say only that prompts and responses are stored on xAI's servers.
